title: Arrearage Management Program — Missed Program Bill Entries
content:
# Arrearage Management Program — Missed Program Bill Entries

**Rule.** A program bill of an Arrearage Management Program plan — the forgiveness kind of Payment Arrangement — whose current charges are still unpaid when its cure period ends is booked as a missed-installment entry for the installment that bill carries, on the day after the cure period ends. The amount the entry records is the missed program-bill amount. The rules of the Payment Arrangement program on cure periods, on counting missed installments and on default are unchanged: the entry counts toward the plan's missed installments like any other missed installment.

## Booking the entry — `record_missed_program_bill_7606bb4e`

**What the tool does.** It records that a program bill of an Arrearage Management Program plan is counted as missed. A missed-installment entry dated today is added to the plan's history for the installment number that bill carries, linked to the bill and carrying the missed amount given. The plan's status and balance are not changed. Afterwards the plan history shows the missed entry.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`, naming `record_missed_program_bill_7606bb4e`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `arrangement_id` | The reference number of the Arrearage Management Program plan, as returned by the payment arrangement lookup | Identifier |
| `installment_number` | The position of the scheduled installment the missed bill carries (1 is the first) | Whole number (integer) |
| `bill_id` | The bill reference number of the program bill counted as missed, as returned by the bill lookup | Identifier |
| `amount` | The missed amount recorded | US dollars with 2 decimal places, a plain number such as 11.91 with no currency sign; stored rounded half-up to the cent |

**Return.** A text receipt: "Missed entry <entry_id> recorded on <arrangement_id> for installment <n>: <amount> USD." The entry identifier is the reference number of the new history entry, the installment number is the one given and the amount carries 2 decimal places. Receiving this receipt means the entry is recorded.

## Timing at a glance (hypothetical program bill)

| Due date | Cure period | Last cure day | Current charges paid in full by the last cure day | Missed-installment entry |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| May 20 | 10 days | May 30 | Yes | None |
| May 20 | 10 days | May 30 | No | Booked on May 31 for the installment the bill carries |
